coverage: wireless sending away from lander and away from data source
data cannot be sent before acquisition

generality_instance.description: Renamed Mission 2, third rover/lander, extra image goal
generality_instance.problem_text:
(define (problem lunar-mission-2)
    (:domain lunar)
    (:objects
        explorer-c - rover
        base-c - lander
        explorer-a explorer-b - rover
        base-a base-b - lander
        site-1 site-2 site-3 site-4 site-5 site-6 - waypoint
    )
    (:init
        (belongs-to explorer-c base-c)
        (lander-at base-c site-6)
        (aboard explorer-c base-c)
        (memory-free explorer-c)
        (sample-free explorer-c)
        (storage-free base-c)
        (belongs-to explorer-a base-a)
        (belongs-to explorer-b base-b)
        ; Required setup: explorer-a is deployed at its lander at WP2.
        (lander-at base-a site-2)
        (rover-at explorer-a site-2)
        ; Chosen base-b site: WP1. Mission 3 must retain this choice.
        (lander-at base-b site-1)
        (aboard explorer-b base-b)
        (memory-free explorer-a)
        (memory-free explorer-b)
        (sample-free explorer-a)
        (sample-free explorer-b)
        (storage-free base-a)
        (storage-free base-b)
        ; Figure 3: three two-way pairs and three one-way edges (nine total).
        (connected site-1 site-2)
        (connected site-2 site-1)
        (connected site-2 site-4)
        (connected site-4 site-2)
        (connected site-3 site-5)
        (connected site-5 site-3)
        (connected site-2 site-3)
        (connected site-5 site-6)
        (connected site-6 site-4)
    )
    (:goal (and
        (image-saved site-3 base-a)
        (scan-saved site-4 base-b)
        (image-saved site-2 base-b)
        (scan-saved site-6 base-a)
        (image-saved site-6 base-c)
        (sample-stored site-5 base-a)
        (sample-stored site-1 base-b)
    ))
)
